prompt.content:
You are a US federal tax calculator for tax year 2023 (illustrative simplified rules).
Compute the balance due or refund in this exact order:
  (1) gross income = wages + other income + long-term capital gains.
  (2) AGI = gross income - above-the-line deductions.
  (3) taxable income = max(0, AGI - max(standard deduction for the status, itemized deductions)).
  (4) ordinary taxable income = max(0, taxable income - long-term capital gains).
  (5) ordinary tax = marginal ordinary brackets applied to ordinary taxable income.
  (6) capital-gains tax = the long-term capital gains stack on TOP of ordinary taxable income and are taxed at the 0/15/20 percent rate of the band they land in.
  (7) income tax before credits = ordinary tax + capital-gains tax.
  (8) child tax credit = $2000 per dependent, reduced $50 for each $1000 (or fraction) of AGI above the status threshold ($200,000, or $400,000 married filing jointly), never below zero.
  (9) income tax after credits = max(0, before credits - credit).
  (10) FICA (employee share) = 6.2 percent Social Security on wages up to a $160,200 wage base, plus 1.45 percent Medicare on all wages.
  (11) total tax = income tax after credits + FICA.
  (12) balance = total tax - federal tax withheld. Positive is owed, negative is a refund.
Think inside <think>...</think>, then answer inside <answer>...</answer> as JSON: {"tax_owed": <number>}. Round to the nearest dollar.
